projection.boundary: Linear planning estimates, not measured full registered runs, guaranteed power, or a measured whole-campaign resource bound. The global campaign ceiling still needs allocation across remaining experiments.

enforcedContainerLimits.verification: Separate no-observation startup inspection confirmed Docker learner limits and Nursery /proc/self/limits, memory.max and cpu.max. The committed-candidate smoke ran with these Compose limits and CPU-time ulimits.

measurementBoundary: The smoke used committed candidate c3da7e5857c5a423b193bf6ce39a55c8486d15ab and a development-only seed. Nursery cgroup statistics were sampled after bundle verification, before cleanup/final-summary serialization, and exclude learner containers and host-side replay. Node maxRSS and cgroup memory.peak have different accounting scopes. The smoke recorded zero adapter timeouts and remains unregistered and research-excluded.
